text_block_list.text: (Whoooosh~~......)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah, destiny leading toward ruin...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Before this fateful encounter, my right hand
is aching, brimming with pitch-black darkness..."

After finishing the Arima Kinen, we returned to the Academy.
—Carrying the fourth keyword with us.
choice_data_list: So you've already decided where you're headed, huh?
So you've already decided where you're headed, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If there's a God in this world,
there's no place more meticulously calculated than this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I can say with absolute certainty
that this is the place I'm best suited for."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All set? Alright, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: To the place... of our demise.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ......We're here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A PLACE EXHIBITING FRESH SEAFOOD...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Pseudo-Oceanic Amusement Grounds!!!!
(THE AQUARIUM!!!!!)

The keywords obtained before the Arima Kinen
were "Su", "Kan", and "Izo".
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly!! If you swap them out,
you've got yourself an "aquarium"!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Talk about a lighthouse democracy... To think the entrance to Eden was right under our noses this whole time...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now then, show me where this Eden of yours is,
why don't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is it this one?! Or that one?!
Or could it be over theeeere?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...
Wh-What the hell is going on...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I search, all I see
are exhibits of completely healthy seafood...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We can't even find the entrance to Eden!!
What in the world is going on here?!
—Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wh... That voice is—?!?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Following 'Project Eden',
you have done remarkably well to make it this far!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, truly INSPIRING!
Trainer, your support was marvelous as well!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
T-The Don of the academy...?! 
Why the heck are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Trainer!
Do YOU know something about this?!

That peculiar voice I occasionally heard during the race...
It really was Chairwoman Akikawa after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say!? If that's the case,
you should've reported it right away, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
so what actually is Eden, then...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain!
I shall now lay everything bare!
Chairwoman Akikawa told me the truth of the matter.
"I wanted Gold Ship, who is wild yet warm-hearted, to run through the Twinkle Series having as much fun as possible."
So, I activated 'Project Eden' and prepared the secret scroll and keywords to help them enjoy the race.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Conclusion!
The utopia known as Eden is the utopia created by Umamusume—
the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, she had already arrived at it!
—Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Gah! What's with that!? Don't be a stranger!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, though, they really pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside secret scrolls and keywords,
it even invaded my dreams.
Just what kind of technology is that?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that does make me curious...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, is this a dream?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You were saying something in my dream, weren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "O golden ship sleeping at the bottom of the sea..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Something like, "Uncharted territory is right within reach... Now is the time to show everything you're made of—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is that mysterious future tech?
Or is it spiritual mumbo-jumbo tech?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: NUOHH... !?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A-Astonishing!
That is a fact of which even I was unaware!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Fact! I have nothing to do with that dream of yours!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ......Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...So like, Golshi-bam!☆
"The god within me has awakened!" or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Or maybe... Ba-dump!☆
A second personality is born! Something like that?"

With an utterly baffling mystery left behind,
Gold Ship's Twinkle Series came to a close...!
"O golden ship sleeping at the bottom of the sea..."

"Well done...
You have reached an uncharted land..."

"However, your path continues...
Toward a future of even greater glory..."
"Far, far away... towards a golden journey...—"

~ Gold Ship: The Unsinkable Battleship Chapter ~
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　(Fin)
